Villa Hanoï Ramatuelle , French Riviera , France 14 guests · 7 bedrooms · 7 bathrooms · 500 sqm Sculpted from concrete and glass, this villa stands at the centre of a huge expanse of manicured lawn. On the terrace overlooking the sea, striking parasols and baby pink deckchairs lend the pool a certain ‘Ocean Drive’ chic. Inside the house, floor-to-ceiling windows and cool white walls ensure that the elegant contemporary design scheme takes centre stage. Designer furniture, poppy colours and neon lighting bring an added, trendy twist. In the lounge-dining room, the vibrant pink table and colourful contemporary artwork on the walls provide a punchy counterpoint to the minimalist refinement of the kitchen. Turquoise, fuchsia and lime green rugs liven up the pearl grey floors of the bedrooms. The villa is just a short stroll from the exclusive Nikki Beach Club, accessible via its own private road. You can also head up to Tahiti Beach for a mojito on the sand, looking out to sea from the colourful terrace of Moorea. As the sun begins to set, head back up to the villa and enjoy the superb view of the Mediterranean from the private swimming pool, as the kids play hide-and-seek in the olive groves. Explore Booking conditions How does the booking process work? Booking with Le Collectionist is both simple and bespoke. Choose a property from our collection, book online or speak to one of our advisors for more details. Once the property is selected and availability is confirmed with the owner, you confirm the booking and its terms. A deposit secures your booking, then our concierge service takes over to arrange all necessary services and make your stay unique. How do I pay for my stay? In order to confirm your booking, you will need to pay a deposit up to 3 business days after signing your contract. You will then have until two months before the start of your rental period to pay the remaining balance. Will I be asked for a security deposit? Before your arrival, you will be asked to pay a deposit to cover any damage. The amount will be specified in your rental contract and can be requested from your advisor before booking. This deposit will be used to cover the cost of replacement or repairs, upon presentation of evidence provided by the owner. No amount will be withheld without a thorough inspection. Are there any options for early check-in or late check-out? Check-in at the property is set at 5 pm and check-out at 10 am. Early check-in or late check-out may be possible depending on availability of the property and approval from the owners. These options are not automatically included and must be requested in advance from your advisor. What are the cancellation terms? You may cancel your contract subject to the following fees: ● Up to 60 days before your arrival: 50% of the total rental amount ● Between 59 days and the check-in day: 100% of the total rental amount Keep your holiday flexible and stay in control should the unexpected happen by registering for insurance when confirming your booking.
